scores.evidence: Both readings, with John 1:1, confess the Son's deity... This study teaches the KJV as printed and notes the difference without scorn
Every truth in the chapter is found in him too... Every problem in John 1 is answered in Jesus
Tier 1 uses a grandfather-and-doorbell analogy; Tier 3 runs a Debate Corner with Colwell, Harner, and Metzger
Says/Means/Asks kept distinct in every walkthrough block, e.g. John 1:1-2's grammar, Genesis echo, then application
Its holders rightly insist on the Spirit's power... categories the chapter doesn't teach are marked 'Assumed Here'
The claim is not that the verb 'literally means' exegesis; it is that John chose a verb of telling
None of them is the source... Abundant life is fullness of life in Christ, not prosperity, ease, or freedom from suffering
Session plan totals 75 minutes exactly; Leader's Map coaches 'When Someone Has No One to Name' and the opposite hard case
John is a voice; Jesus is the Word... points toward John 20:31's stated purpose repeatedly
